interface.name: mothership_map_pointer_v1

description.summary: nested Map View pointer routing

interface.description: The accepted Command Center surface can enable vertical wheel events inside the frame and left-button sequences in the mapped, focused Map View. Coordinates are logical and local to the nested viewport. Arcade can separately opt in to passive aim coordinates while that same Map View owns keyboard focus. There is no global pointer observer or grab.

description.summary: route vertical wheel to the visible map during navigation
completed left click on empty canvas of the active Map View

event.name: contact

description.summary: scoped primary button sequence

event.description: Motion is sent only while a sequence began in empty nested space during Map View. Cancel ends the sequence without a click. Without begin, motion and end have no effect. Version 3 uses this event instead of click.

description.summary: passive arcade pointer; invalid when outside the active frame
primary or secondary button owned by the focused arcade
unmodified Meta released in a focused nested app, Node, or Map

request.name: set_video_frost

description.summary: draw frosted glass behind the visible Map using the wallpaper buffer

request.description: Only the watched Command Center may set this state. The margin is in logical pixels; the compositor samples its existing wallpaper texture.

request.name: set_node_strip

description.summary: place the watched panel's active-Node preview strip

request.description: Logical viewport rectangle. Zero width hides it. The compositor uses only existing buffers of the current Node; no pixels or app identities are returned to the client.

description.summary: open App Grid after the nested seat handled Meta+A
open Node Panel Settings after the nested seat handled Meta+comma
request the active Node's current chooser rows
activate a row in the last chooser snapshot; zero ID dismisses
number of windows eligible for the preview tray in the active Node
number of eligible tray windows not visible in the painted preview lane
place one active overflow thumbnail; pixels stay in the compositor
set the keyboard chooser's preview zoom percentage
activate this displayed Node number without moving keyboard focus to the panel
query the native output; only the watched shell may request this
commit an advertised mode and scale to the native output
apply result: 0 rejected, 1 active and saved, 2 active but not saved

request.name: highlight_redraw

description.summary: retired compatibility request

request.description: No effect. Reserved for clients built against protocol version 17.

description.summary: apply a saved logical pointer size on the watched shell

request.name: set_scene_glass

description.summary: set popup glass bounds and paint opacity

request.description: Coordinates are in logical output space. Opacity is 0–1000; zero stops sampling and hides the glass.

event.name: scene_glass_available

description.summary: advertise scene-glass slots to the watched panel

event.description: Bit n means the compositor can attempt the GPU effect for slot n. A clear bit leaves the panel's paint-only fallback in control.

description.summary: open scoped Slash from a Node shortcut
get group layout for the pointed-at tray thumbnail
apply group layout or a single group action
group settings snapshot scoped to the active node
anchor Group Settings to the shared frame's Layout control
open Notification Log for the active Node
authorize the watched, launcher-owned Panel for screenshots

event.name: screenshot_frame

description.summary: frozen output in RGBA8888 byte order

event.description: The fd starts at byte zero and contains stride times height bytes. Window targets for this frame arrive before this event.

description.summary: window target in logical output coordinates, sent back to front
isolated window image in the same pixel format as the frame
capture error or invalidation, terminal closes the overlay
set the Node preview strip's hover zoom percentage

event.name: node_switch_step

description.summary: start or advance the held Node switching gesture

event.description: Direction is 1 for Tab and -1 for Shift+Tab. The first step captures the chooser's candidates from its live Node state.

event.name: node_switch_finish

description.summary: finish the held Node switching gesture

event.description: Commit is 1 when the last Meta key is released, or 0 when the gesture is canceled. An open chooser can request selection once on commit.

request.name: window_list

description.summary: list every live mapped toplevel for Slash window search

request.description: The compositor answers with window_list_row events and one window_list_end carrying the same serial. Titles and app IDs stay on this shell connection; no pixels are sent.

event.name: node_move

description.summary: move a focused window to this displayed Node number

event.description: Sent after the nested seat handled Meta+Shift plus a Node number key on a focused app window. The shell resolves the number and submits the assignment; slot 1 returns the window to Inbox.

event.name: pin_state

description.summary: the comms pin's painted box, or width 0 when hidden

event.description: The compositor draws the pinned window's live thumbnail; the shell paints the label strip (the top PIN_HEADER logical px of the box) and the unpin mark at its right end. Title and app ID stay on this shell connection. A new non-zero window ID is sent at once when a window is pinned, even while hidden; ID 0 means nothing is pinned.

event.name: beam

description.summary: a preview card dragged up out of the Node tray

event.description: Phase 0 begins at the card's center, 1 follows the pointer, 2 drops and 3 cancels. The shell shows its Node strip as the drop target, hit-tests it, and submits the assignment on a drop. Pointer positions stay on this shell connection.

description.summary: a click on the comms pin asks to connect to its window
